svg.aria-label: Operator Labs. Two independent, offline Python tools. Corridor Lab compares declared, fictional cross-border payment routes. TraceCanary detects privacy regressions in synthetic OTLP trace exports. Shown as two routes between the same two endpoints, beside a trace waterfall where a sweep turns one leaking span red.
